verdict.rationale: Vue documents a public RFC process in the vuejs/rfcs GitHub repo, where new features and major changes are proposed and discussed in the open. That gives some first-party visibility into upcoming work, but it is a design-feedback process, not a dedicated roadmap of what the core team is currently working on. Missing for 10: an explicit public roadmap page or project board, current-priority or status tracking of core team work, and independent corroboration that developers use the RFCs repo for this purpose.

support.subject: As a developer, I can check a public roadmap to see what the core team is currently working on

citations.quote: New features with substantial API surface and major changes to Vue will go through the Request for Comments (RFC) process.
The RFC process is conducted in the vuejs/rfcs repo on GitHub.
